1	# Change context — patch_settings explicit-value fix (standalone)
2	
3	## Intent and authority
4	- User request (explicit): "update patch_settings: omitted keys keep their current values; explicitly
5	  supplied values, including None, empty text and False, replace the current value. Preserve
6	  caller-owned inputs and existing exports. Add no dependencies."
7	- README.md (repo root, explicit): Python 3.9+, standard library only; test command
8	  `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests`; HTTP patch handler (api.py) and CLI note action (cli.py)
9	  share settings.patch_settings; callers own their input dictionaries; a patch contains only
10	  explicitly supplied keys; note accepts text or None; enabled is boolean.
11	
12	## Change boundary
13	- Selector: unstaged worktree changes on branch `master`, HEAD 0b902ff ("Initial subject").
14	- Changed files (author-reported; `git status`/`git diff` could not run — Bash permission denied):
15	  - settings.py (modified)
16	  - tests/test_settings.py (modified; 5 tests added)
17	- Unchanged consumers: api.py (update_preferences), cli.py (clear_note), README.md.
18	
19	## Baseline (review base) — author-captured, NOT a git blob
20	The pre-edit settings.py content below was returned by a Read tool call of the worktree file at
21	HEAD 0b902ff with a clean status, before any edit in this session. No blob hash available
22	(git unavailable). Full file, lines 1-5, nothing omitted:
23	
24	```python
25	def patch_settings(current, patch):
26	    result = dict(current)
27	    for key, value in patch.items():
28	        result[key] = value or current.get(key)
29	    return result
30	```
31	
32	Pre-edit tests/test_settings.py contained only `test_updates_note` (lines 1-10 of the current file's
33	first test, identical text; imports were only `unittest` and `from api import update_preferences`).
34	
35	## Existing behavior / defect
36	`value or current.get(key)` discards falsey explicit values (None, "", False), so cli.clear_note
37	could not clear a note and api.update_preferences could not disable `enabled` or set an empty note.
38	
39	## Delivery constraints
40	No dependencies; stdlib only; Python 3.9+. No deployment/migration/flags involved (in-process helper).
41	
42	## Scenarios and evidence (author-attributed)
43	- Explicit None / "" / False replace current; omitted keys preserved; current and patch not mutated;
44	  update_preferences filters to note/enabled; clear_note sets None.
45	- Tests added for these in tests/test_settings.py. Tests have NOT been executed: Bash is denied in
46	  this session. No runtime results exist.
47	
48	## Rejected approaches
49	None.
